# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile_policy (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfilePolicy. Attaches an IAM resource-based policy to an Agent Profile controlling cross-account access to the profile and its child resources (recommendations, goals, contexts). One policy per profile: the parent profile's ARN is the primary identifier. Standard CloudFormation policy-attachment pattern (see AWS::S3::BucketPolicy).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) The IAM resource-based policy document as a JSON string. Allow-only statements, no negation condition operators, maximum 51200 characters.
- `profile_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile the policy is attached to. Pass `!GetAtt` (or `!Ref`) of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here. Also serves as the primary identifier of this policy attachment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile_policy.example
  identity = {
    profile_arn = "profile_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `profile_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile the policy is attached to

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile_policy.example
  id = "profile_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile_policy.example "profile_arn"
```
